## Change

Describe the complete user-visible outcome and any limitations.

## Evidence

- [ ] Tests and failure paths checked (list actual commands/results below).
- [ ] English documentation and API contract updated where applicable.
- [ ] Migration, recovery and compatibility effects reviewed.
- [ ] No unsupported security, completeness or publishing claims.

## Release

Use a Conventional Commit PR title. `feat`, breaking changes, and significant
capabilities require `release:feature`; that label requires a release-producing
title. Use `!` in the title for breaking changes and explain the migration here.
The protected-main workflow publishes only after validation and verification.
